title: Build functional weekly schedule editor
acceptance_criteria: Each weekday can be assigned zero or more saved routines with a valid local time.
Users can add, edit, and remove a day assignment and the weekly view clearly distinguishes rest days from scheduled sessions.
The editor uses the pure schedule functions and persists changes through the versioned storage adapter rather than duplicating recurrence logic.
Invalid or missing routine selections are rejected with clear English feedback and no partial corrupt write.
Component tests cover assignment, edit, removal, rest-day rendering, and invalid input behavior.
